scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @supreme/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @supreme/storage && npm run typecheck --workspace @supreme/runtime && npm run typecheck --workspace @supreme/renderer && npm run typecheck --workspace @supreme/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @supreme/shared && npm run build --workspace @supreme/storage && npm run build --workspace @supreme/runtime && npm run build --workspace @supreme/renderer && npm run build --workspace @supreme/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,desktop -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @supreme/renderer" "npm run dev --workspace @supreme/desktop"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build --workspace @supreme/renderer && npm run build --workspace @supreme/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build --workspace @supreme/renderer && npm run package --workspace @supreme/desktop
